features.quote: Iteration limit: 10 attempts per task before termination
Why fixed 10 iterations? Provides consistent observation window; Long enough to observe trajectory; Short enough to complete runs in reasonable time
features.justification_quote: Short enough to complete runs in reasonable time

features.quote: Concern: Could this research develop techniques for causing model 'distress'? Response: Distress responses appear to be task-specific artifacts rather than fundamental suffering
features.justification_quote: Distress responses appear to be task-specific artifacts rather than fundamental suffering; No evidence this transfers to harmful capabilities
